title: <role>'s in
description: What the main conversation gives the role <role>: its run values as it starts, and the person's answer as it resumes it. The role's part names this file, and the guard limits the role's calls to the run values.

start.description: The run values, one JSON object on the first line of the prompt that starts the role, each one a value that the guard limits the role's calls to, such as the path of the file it writes. The rest of the prompt, where there is any, holds the request as given.

<value>.description: <What the value is>, such as the path of the file the role writes.

resume.description: The message by which the main conversation resumes the role with SendMessage: its first line, then its decision on the role's last result and why, and, where the person answered, a line that opens the person's words as they wrote them, because a summary loses what the person meant.
